prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1252; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the parking lot collision in Houston, Texas?

A: Yes, I was driving. I'd pulled into a spot near the back entrance of the shopping center.

Q: Walk me through what happened as you were leaving the space.

A: I was backing out slowly, checking my mirrors. The other car was coming down the aisle fast, and I didn't see it until the last second. We hit on the rear driver's side panel of my car.

Q: Were you moving at the time of impact?

A: Barely. I'd say I was rolling at walking speed, maybe a little faster.

Q: Did anyone else witness the collision?

A: A man came over after and asked if we were okay. I don't know if he saw the actual impact.

Q: Did you have your seatbelt on?

A: Yes, I always do.

Q: Did you notice any injuries right away?

A: Not at first. I felt fine for about an hour, then my lower back started tightening up. By that evening it was pretty bad, a sharp pain when I bent or lifted anything.

Q: Have you seen a doctor about it?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning. They diagnosed a back strain and told me to rest and take anti-inflammatories. I'm still doing physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Have you had any prior back problems?

A: No, nothing serious. I had some stiffness years ago after moving furniture, but it went away on its own.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I want this handled fairly, and I'm willing to provide my medical records.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
